other_conditions: Only partnership and proprietary concerns are eligible.
For proprietary concerns, ownership must be 100% women.
For partnership firms, women must hold at least 51% ownership.
In partnership firms the remaining 49% share must not be entirely held by husband, father, brother, or son, and there must be at least one additional partner other than these relatives.
Units must have entered commercial production or service on or after the date of publication of the scheme.
benefits_summary: Provides interest subsidies (up to ₹5 lakh per annum) and additional employment subsidies, with preferential treatment under capital‑contribution schemes for eligible women‑owned units.
